create_mccfr_solver: create an MCCFR solver instance for a game to compute counterfactual regret minimization strategies
build_average_policy: build an average policy object from MCCFR solver infostates to retrieve action probabilities for players
run_regret_matching: run regret matching on a numpy array of regrets to produce a probability distribution over actions
lookup_infostate_info: lookup or initialize infostate regret and average strategy arrays for a given information state key
add_regret_and_strategy: add cumulative regret and average strategy amounts to a specific action in an infostate
